name: Beck Scale for Suicide Ideation (BSS/BSSI)
note: 19 scored items, each 0–2. No universal validated cutoff that can determine individual suicide risk.

name: Adult Psychiatric Morbidity Survey suicide-history items
note: History is clinically relevant but does not determine current or future risk by itself.

name: Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II)
note: Common descriptive bands: 0–13 minimal, 14–19 mild, 20–28 moderate, 29–63 severe.

name: Perceived Stress Scale – 4 item (PSS-4)
note: Higher scores indicate more perceived stress; no diagnostic cutoff.

name: Warwick–Edinburgh Mental Well-Being Scale (WEMWBS-14)
note: Higher scores indicate greater wellbeing; interpretation is population/context dependent.

name: Defeat Scale
note: Higher scores indicate greater subjective defeat; no invented clinical cutoff.

name: ENRICHD Social Support Instrument (ESSI)
rights: Exact form/reproduction status must be verified
note: Higher scores generally indicate greater perceived support.

name: Socially Prescribed Perfectionism subscale
note: Use validated norms and exact version-specific scoring.

name: Interpersonal Needs Questionnaire (INQ-12)
note: Preserve burdensomeness and belongingness as separate subscales.

name: Life Orientation Test – Revised (LOT-R)
rights: Exact reproduction status/version must be verified
note: 10 prompts; 6 scored and 4 fillers; negative items are reversed.

name: Connor–Davidson Resilience Scale – 10 item (CD-RISC-10)
rights: Copyright/licensing applies — item text not embedded
note: Higher scores indicate greater resilience; use population-appropriate norms.

name: Acquired Capability for Suicide Scale (ACSS)
rights: Version and reproduction status must be verified
note: Multiple forms exist; version must be frozen before scoring and scores must not be mixed across forms.

name: Barratt Impulsiveness Scale Version 11 (BIS-11)
rights: Verify reproduction status; use authoritative key
note: 30 items with reverse-keyed items; preserve attentional, motor and nonplanning factors.

name: Exposure to Suicide / Self-Harm items
construct: Exposure through self, family, friends or others
rights: Exact source wording/version must be verified
note: Contextual exposure information is not a deterministic risk score.

name: Suicide / Self-Harm Mental Imagery items
rights: Exact source and reproduction status must be verified
note: Use as a structured research/clinical signal, not as a stand-alone risk category.
